description: SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. Coverage: SIG-GR @ Ministère du Logement et de l'Aménagement du territoire - Département de l’aménagement du territoire. The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Cross-border bus lines 09/2015; Cross-border bus lines Lorraine-Saarland in 2026; Cross-border bus lines Luxembourg-Wallonia in 2026; Cross-border bus lines Luxembourg-Wallonia in 2022. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
